title: Headquarters Integration Layer config
description: Reference contract for factory/hq.config.json. Optional file; factory/lib/hq/config.mjs supplies defaults for anything missing.

workspaceRoots.description: Folders scanned for sibling project repositories. '~' is expanded; relative paths resolve against the HQ root.

ignore.description: Directory names never treated as a project.

maxDepth.description: How deep below each workspace root to look for a .git directory.

enabled.description: Master switch for all read-only `gh` calls.
